inscription-materials-ah-price-guide.htm.intro_description: Every row below is an actual tradeable item that can be posted on the Auction House. Each price band was audited from the exact 3.3.5 recipe, minimum guaranteed output, this guide set's matching reagent references, and a modest demand-sensitive crafting margin. Prices are per finished item; recheck the live AH before crafting a batch, and do not add a cooldown premium when this server shortens or removes that cooldown.

shared_note.label: Craft-cost pricing
shared_note.text: Each price band was recalculated from the exact 3.3.5 ink, parchment, and other recipe quantities, the minimum guaranteed output, and a modest demand margin. Darkmoon Card of the North results are random, so exact-card and completed-deck prices must also reflect missing-rank scarcity. Recheck the live ink, glyph, card, and deck markets before crafting; sell glyphs and scrolls mostly as singles or small stacks.

alchemy-materials-ah-price-guide.html.intro_description: This expanded catalog covers tradeable Alchemy outputs across Wrath, Outland, and Classic: flasks, elixirs, potions, protection consumables, oils, cauldrons, intermediates, and selected transmutes. Every price band was recalculated from the exact 3.3.5 recipe, minimum guaranteed output, recursively priced intermediates, and this guide set's matching reagent references. Prices are per finished item or listed stack; specialization procs are upside rather than part of the floor, so recheck the live AH and server-specific behavior before crafting a batch.

shared_note.label: Craft-cost pricing
shared_note.text: Each price band was recalculated from the exact 3.3.5 recipe quantities, the minimum guaranteed output, and a demand-sensitive crafting margin; Alchemy-specialization procs are upside, not assumed output. Standard flasks occupy both elixir slots and persist through death, while ordinary potions share the potion cooldown. Recheck live inputs and finished-item competition before crafting, especially for older or server-rule-dependent uses.
